title: Processing Charge on Courtesy Permit Cancellations by Meal Status, Student Transportation Services Refund Schedule
content:
The processing charge taken from a Student Transportation Services courtesy rider permit cancellation credit follows the meal status the student holds on the last day of service in the School Nutrition Services Meal Account, because the district's fee waivers extend to it.

| Meal status held on the last day of service | Processing charge |
|---|---|
| any Free Meal Status tier (Household Application, Direct Certification, Categorical Eligibility or Prior-Year Carryover) | none |
| any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier (Reduced-Price Meal Status or Reduced-Price Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover)) | 5.00 USD |
| any other student: Paid Meal Status, or no meal account | 10.00 USD |

The status read is the one held on the last day of service, which is the day the parent or guardian confirms the cancellation.

## Examples (hypothetical)

- A student who moved from Paid Meal Status to Reduced-Price Meal Status before the cancellation is confirmed pays 5.00.
- A student with no meal account pays 10.00.
